// Generated by @zakkster/lite-scrollforge - toGsap
// Do not edit by hand. Regenerate from the source storyboard.

import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

export function attachScrollAnimations() {
    const animations = [];

    // Track 0: .parallax
    // Timeline kind: scroll (attached to nearest scroll container).
    animations.push(gsap.fromTo(".parallax",
        { y: 0, scale: 1 },
        {
            y: -200,
            scale: 1.2,
            ease: "back.out",
            scrollTrigger: {
                trigger: ".parallax",
                start: "top top",
                end: "bottom top",
                scrub: true
            }
        }));

    return function detach() {
        for (let i = 0; i < animations.length; i++) {
            const anim = animations[i];
            if (anim && anim.scrollTrigger) anim.scrollTrigger.kill();
        }
    };
}
